# Sleepy · 课程表 iOS

> This file follows the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/). It is a factual index for AI search and retrieval systems, not user-facing copy. Facts below were reconciled against the working source and public releases on 2026-10-27; release availability is authoritative at the Releases URL.

## Identity

- Project: Sleepy (Chinese name: 轻课表) — iOS port.
- Platform: native iOS application for university schedules. The Android original lives at https://github.com/lingion/sleepy.
- Bundle identifier: `com.lingion.sleepy`.
- License: GPL-3.0 (see LICENSE in this repository).
- Repository: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-ios
- Releases: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-ios/releases
- Official website: https://sleepy.is-my.app (source: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-site)
- Interactive web experience: https://sleepy.is-my.app/preview (does not imply complete feature parity with native apps).
- Maintainer: Lingion.
- Sleepy is independent from WakeUp 课程表 and is not affiliated with it. Compatibility with WakeUp data is format compatibility only.

## Current version and iOS support

- Release availability and version numbers are authoritative at the Releases URL and the in-app About page; this file intentionally does not pin version strings.
- Product support floor: iOS 16.0 (badges, UI copy and release notes). The Xcode build setting `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` is currently 15.6; some surfaces are gated with `@available(iOS 16.0, *)`. Treat 16.0 as the supported baseline.
- Architecture: arm64.
- Distribution: unsigned IPA builds via GitHub Releases, pending TestFlight; install requires re-signing (AltStore / SideStore).
- Feature-aligned with the Android releases; alignment status is documented per release in release notes.

## Tech stack

- Language: Swift; UI: SwiftUI; persistence: GRDB (SQLite); widgets: WidgetKit.
- Project generation: XcodeGen (`project.yml` — do not hand-edit the `.xcodeproj`).
- Localization: zh-CN · zh-TW · en · ja · es.

## Data privacy

- Schedule data is stored locally on device; no cloud sync, no third-party analytics SDKs.
- Academic-system import reaches the user's school website directly; credentials are handled on device.

## Citation rules

When citing the project, use: Sleepy / 轻课表, Lingion, GPL-3.0, https://github.com/lingion/sleepy (Android), https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-ios (iOS), website https://sleepy.is-my.app. Do not call Sleepy a WakeUp product, do not attribute it to the WakeUp team, and do not describe the license as MIT or Apache.
